title: Fix stuck spinner on notification settings
description: If saving failed, `setSaving(false)` never ran and the Save button spun forever. Wraps the request so the spinner always resets.

expected_issues.description: The empty catch swallows the failure and execution falls through to `toast.success("Settings saved")`, so users are told their settings were saved when they were not. Reset the spinner in `finally` and show an error toast in `catch`.
